svg.title: Predicted recall of one week of lectures under three study strategies
svg.text: Spread-out self-testing keeps more, with fewer sessions
Predicted recall of one week of lectures, examined four weeks later (FSRS-4.5 memory model).
Cramming is marginally ahead on exam day: 99.6% against 98.8%.
A model's prediction with population-default weights, not a measurement of students. Dots: study sessions. benchmarks/figures.py
